user.title: Configure battery runtime
user.description: Select sensors for this battery. The home consumption sensor must report non-negative whole-home demand, not grid import or export. Capacity must be the usable, deliverable energy from 0% to 100% at the same measurement boundary as the battery power sensor.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure battery runtime
reconfigure.description: Changing a source entity or the battery discharge sign resets learned history. Changing the name, capacity, reserve, or discharge threshold preserves learned history.

error.already_configured: A battery runtime entry already uses this battery state-of-charge and battery power entity pair.
error.entity_not_found: The selected entity does not currently exist.
error.entity_not_numeric: The selected entity must currently have a finite numeric value.
error.invalid_capacity: Capacity must be a finite value greater than 0 kWh.
error.invalid_power_sign: Select whether positive or negative battery power means discharge.
error.invalid_power_unit: The selected power entity must use W or kW.
error.invalid_reserve: Reserve state of charge must be between 0% and 99%.
error.invalid_soc_unit: The battery state of charge entity must use %.
error.invalid_soc_value: The battery state of charge must currently be between 0% and 100%.
error.invalid_threshold: The discharge threshold must be a finite value of 0 W or greater.
error.negative_home_consumption: Home consumption must currently be non-negative. Select a whole-home demand sensor rather than grid import or export.

abort.already_configured: A battery runtime entry already uses this battery state-of-charge and battery power entity pair.
